decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been provided to conclude that the proposals would be lawful within the meaning of Schedule 2, Part 6, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, as amended. The plans submitted do not show clearly how any new surfacing would exceed the 25 metre from classified road requirement, nor does the submission clarify to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority that the purpose of the submission and operational development described would be for agricultural purposes.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for proposed operational development in the form of engineering operations to consolidate and extend existing agricultural hardstanding. No buildings or structures are proposed. The works involve the laying of clean, inert, permeable aggregate as part of a unified agricultural yard. The development is reasonably necessary for the purposes of agriculture under Part 6, Class A of the GPDO.
